Migrated 25 on-premise servers to AWS. Uptime went from 99.2% to 99.9%. Cut hosting costs by $180k a year.

Managed 12 engineers across infrastructure, security and cloud. Shipped the Securian-to-Cetera cutover with zero downtime, which nobody on the floor believed was possible until the Monday after.

Built an agent orchestration system on Claude Code that automated code review. Review time fell from 2 hours to 15 minutes. The part that did not work was the first attempt at batching, which I threw away after a week. The second attempt is the one that shipped, and it is the one I would build again.
